highlights: Comprehensive Child Safeguarding Policy based on The Child Protection Act B.E. 2546 and UN Declaration
Designated Safeguarding Leads and Departmental Child Protection Officers (CPOs)
Strict recruitment policies and background checks
Crisis Team and Child Protection Response Team
safety.policy_summary: RAIS maintains a comprehensive child safeguarding policy designed to protect students from all forms of harm and abuse. The school employs rigorous recruitment procedures with background checks, staff codes of conduct, structured reporting and investigation protocols, and dedicated Child Protection Officers across different departments.
